changelog:
- Initial release of doc-beautifier.
- Beautifies .docx files using a consistent, professional look.
- Heuristically detects and formats document titles, headings (up to 3 levels), and body text.
- Includes 3 built-in template styles: standard, compact, and elegant.
- Adjusts fonts, sizes, spacing, indentation, margins, and page layout; preserves all original text.
- Customization supported via the script’s template dictionary.
summary: Beautify Word documents (.docx) using a professional general template. Trigger when the user asks to: beautify/美化/排版/格式化 a Word document, apply a template/style to a .docx file, make a document look professional/clean/formatted, or clean up a document's formatting. Works by reading the source .docx,
